buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Service Category: Vehicle Hiring Service - Without Fuel (Fuel cost & Charge for overtime duty (if applicable) to be reimbursed on actual basis. ) Description of Services: Hiring of a school bus (with minimum seating capacity of 52+ or - 5%) to ply from Panchet to Loyola School, Ta ldanga and vice versa for a period of 02 (two) years from the dat e of actual commencement of work subject to authorization of v ehicle beyond 31/10/2026. Minimum run is 1200 KM and Maximu m KM is 1500KM. Requirement is 1500KM. Scope of The Work 1. A Bus with a seating capacity of 52 (+5%) (fifty-two) should be provided. It will ply from Panchet to Loyol a School, Taldanga and vice versa. The bus will be utilised for other purposes of the Corporation as per req uirement. 2. Minimum kilometre of run required by the vehicle per month: 1200 kms. 3. Maximum kilometre of run required by the vehicle per month: 1500 kms. 4. Maximum days of engagement of the vehicle per month: 28, 29, 30, or 31 days as the case may be. 5. Normal duty hours on each day: 9 (Nine) hours. 6. One driver & one helper (khalasi) have to provided.

7. OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. In case of major breakdown or withdrawal of the vehicle from service by the contractor or any reason whatsoever, the contractor shall immediately provide similar vehicle duly approved by the Manager (H R)/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet. Withdrawal of the vehicle by contractor shall be do ne with prior approval of the said official only against the replacement by similar substitute. For servicin g of vehicle, a free time of maximum twenty-four hours will be allowed once every complete month duri ng daytime. The choice of such period for servicing shall be that of the DVC officials against sufficient n otice by the contractor. 2. The contractor shall have to produce necessary documentary evidence in su pport of servicing done, failing which the same will be treated as unauthorize d and penalty as deemed fit to be imposed. For obtaining fitness certificate fr om statutory registering authority, the vehicle shall be released for one comp lete day for every three months without levying any penalty provided a suitab le substitute vehicle is arranged. But mileage covered to and from for fitness check purpose shall not be taken into account for payment. Documentary evi dence of such certificate obtained shall be furnished: otherwise, it will be trea ted as unauthorized absence. 3. The odometer of the vehicle shall be perfectly in order and in case of defect the same shall be immedi ately repaired / rectified at the contractor’s cost. For the period the odometer is not in order, and KM ru n is not recorded in the Log Book, payment shall not be made. 4. The Detailed Route Chart with Timings etc. will be given to the successful contractor after placement o f order. As the vehicle timings are subjected to change of school session and Timing and Route Chart S chedule of vehicles are also subjected to change and will be issued/informed to the successful contracto r before the change of the timing of the school. The vehicle may be sent for out station duty, if required, as per instruction / advice of the Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet for carrying out emergency official work both in Jharkhand & West Bengal. The driver will have to make arrangemen t for the vehicle and his own accommodation, food & lodging etc. at his own cost. 5. The vehicle shall be engaged only for official duty of the Concerned Section as described in SCOPE OF WORK, during the engagement days of contract period and shall not be used by the contractor on other days for any other purpose except with specific approval of the Authority. 6. The vehicle provided by the Contractor for the school duty Panchet to Loyola School, Taldanga and vice versa will be inspected frequently by the DVC authorities. 7. Employment of Drivers/Khalasis/Helpers/Conductors/Supervisory Staff in connection with the service s of vehicles is entirely the responsibility of the Contractor, and DVC Authority is in no way related / resp onsible for their employment/employability or any other claim thereof. The owner of the vehicles shall a bide by all sorts of labour laws as applicable from time to time. 8. The contractor of the vehicle will be responsible for safe traveling of the passengers concerned. Safety, punctuality and their comfort are the essence of the contract. 9. The vehicle should have a Board marked “ON DVC PANCHET SCHOOL DUTY” In bold and prominent l etters. These Boards should be placed before the windscreen of the respective vehicle. 10. All taxes, duties, insurance premium, permits applicable as per law or to be levied in future during th e contractual period in respect of vehicle shall have to be borne by the contractor and is required to fur

nish up-to-date documents of such payment during the period of contract to the Manager (HR)/any othe r officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet for verification. 11. The Contractor shall place the vehicle along with Driver (s) and Khalasi (s) (if required) of the vehicle at the disposal of the Concerned Authority for deployment of different duties according to the requirem ents as mentioned in the “Scope of work”. 12. The contractor shall have to comply with the statutory provisions applicable in respect of providing co mmercial vehicle on hiring basis. The contractor shall bear all charges for running the vehicle and all re muneration and facilities of Operators/Supervisory Staff etc. involved with the vehicle services. 13. The vehicle will perform day to day work / duty of the Concerned Section and also other incidental tri ps, essential administrative work of GOI / Govt. of W.B./ Govt. of Jharkhand as per direction of Manager/ any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet. 14. Contractor also must produce valid permit (s), Road Tax, Registration of vehicle, fitness certificate in r espect of the vehicle with comprehensive insurance and Pollution Clearance Certificate after obtaining t he same to the Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet for verification. Contractor sh ould renew the Insurance Policy, Pollution Clearance Certificate and other required documents of the ve hicle throughout the tenure of the contract. 15. SUB-LETTING & ASSIGNMENT: During the period of contract, the vehicle shall exclusively be used as per the direction of the Authority Concerned. The hired vehicle shall not be sublet during the contrac t period, nor shall any unauthorized person be allowed to travel by the vehicle within the contract perio d. 16. All suits arising out of this NIT, if any, are subject to the jurisdiction in the city of Ranchi (earlier Kolkat a) in India and no other court. 17. It is the obligation of the contractor to comply with the provisions of all laws, rules, orders and regulati ons and notifications whether Central or State or Local as applicable to him or to the agreement from ti me to time. 18. The vehicle will be inspected frequently by the DVC Authorities. The vehicle shall be kept in running c ondition at all times and procurement of fuel, lubricants, spares etc. will be arranged by contractor at h is own cost. Routine maintenance, repairs, frequent check-up, servicing, overhauling, payment of wage s to drivers, cleaners and conductors, etc. will be the contractor’s liability. 19. The contractor shall not pay less than minimum wages to the workers under the Minimum Wages Act and the Govt. rules made there under subject to revision from time to time. Also, the copies of the pay ment voucher on the above should be produced in every month during the period of contract to the Ma nager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet/ DVC authority for verification. 20. No separate rates for engagement of the vehicle on Sundays and Holidays will be admissible. The pay ment to the driver for engagement on Sundays / Holidays as per Statutory Regulations will be owner's ( contractor's) account without any reflection in the contract value.

21 . Requirements i.r.o. the vehicle: - A. The requirement of vehicle is non-AC Diesel Engine Driven. B. The vehicle should in good running condition with registration not older than 05 (five) ye ars from the date of NIT, having cushioned seats and back rests, Interior upholstery and decor ation should be good. Vehicle should be in roadworthy condition, all safety measures and arr angements e.g. WIPER, Window Railings, Door Locks, Handles, Grips, windowpanes etc. shoul d be in perfect condition. C. The vehicle should be equipped with a spare wheel, set of Tools, FIRST AID BOX and othe r necessary requisites. The vehicle should be mechanically perfect in respect of Brake Syste m, Steering System, Suspension System, Tyres, Horn, Headlight, Indicator etc. The vehicle pr ovided by the contractor should comply with all the legal formalities in respect of State Motor Vehicle Act and State Govt. /Central Govt. Pollution Norms and other Acts/Regulations implem ented from time to time. D. It should have all features as mentioned in the document no: TC/JK/PS/97-105, dated 02-0 2-2012 as advised by the Hon’ble supreme court. This document is provided separately in the NIT. In case of non-compliance, penalty will be imposed as mentioned in the penalty clause. 22. Driver(s) engaged must possess valid Public Service Driving Licence for Public service/commercial ve hicles. Driver(s) should be well trained to meet the emergency situations, e.g. breakdown, accident and other eventualities. Moreover, the Driver engaged must be Obedient and responsible enough to dischar ge the duty properly, failing of which the contractor has to replace him immediately if any unfavourable report is reported against him. 23. Police verification & medical check-ups of driver & khalasi must be furnished before they will be engaged on duty, if not, they will not be allowed to for duty and the duration till the verifications are not submitted, it will be treated that driver(s) & khalasi(s) are not engage d and penalty will be imposed accordingly. Driver(s) & Khalasi (s) should not consume alcoh ol, cigarettes, any other banned substance which may affect the behaviour, duty. They sho uld be perfectly mentally & physically fit for the duty and should be free from all illnesses w hich affect the duty. 24. Starting point for the purpose of calculation of run of the vehicle in Kilometre for the payment of Runni ng Charges will be from the reporting point as per direction of the Manager/any Other officer, HR Depar tment, DVC, Panchet. 25. In case of absence of regular driver, one standby driver must be made available. The standby driver must possess valid gate pass / driving license etc.. 26. The vehicle shall be kept in running condition at all times and procurement of fuel, lubricants, spare s etc. will be arranged by Contractor at his own cost. Routine maintenance, repairs, frequent check-u p, servicing overhauling, payment of wages to Drivers/Helpers/Conductors/Supervisory Staff etc. will b e the contractor's liability.

27. The vehicle will be authorised for different journeys as per direction, Time & Route Chart issued by t he Concerned Authority or their authorised representative and as such, the Drivers / Conductors of ve hicle will have to perform duties as per itinerary Instruction of the Manager/any Other officer, HR Dep artment, DVC, Panchet. The time & route chart must strictly be adhered to. 28. Reporting point of the vehicle will be at some place of Panchet as per direction of Manager (HR) . 29. The EPF & MP Act 1952, The ESI Act 1948, the Bonus Act 1965, the Gratuity Act 1971, th e CL (R&A) Act 1971, the Maternity benefit Act 1961, the Payment of wages Act 1936, the Minimum Wages Act 1948, the Child Labour (Prohibition & Regulation) Act 1986 and all rul es & regulations mentioned therein must be complied religiously as per applicability. 30. Contractor must ensure strict adherence to all statutory provisions of the law of land as and when comes into effect. He must ensure all social security provisions like Pradhan Ma ntri Suraksha Bhima Yojana (PMSBY), and others directed by DVC, to all workers engaged by them. 31. In case of breakdown of the vehicle during any trip, it should be the endeavour of the Contractor or his representative to get it repaired or to arrange alternative vehicle as early as possible and complet e the trip and schedule journey. Failure to comply with the above will be treated as failure to provide t he vehicle trip, and penalty will be imposed as per the appropriate sub-clause of the PENALTY CLAUSE . 32. A set of Logbooks shall be maintained by the contractor for every calendar month, to be indicated t herein, the Date, Time details, Details of journey and Mileage covered at the end of each trip duly cert ified by Contractor and endorsed by Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet. A pair of such LOGBOOKS shall be maintained for odd and even calendar months. 33. On expiry of the contract period, the contractor must deposit all the LOGBOOKS maintained through out the contractual period to the Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet. 34. The contractor shall pay the parking charges / toll taxes wherever required and the same will be rei mbursed against the documentary evidence. 35. DVC shall have no responsibility for any damage to the vehicle by destruction or otherwise for any r eason whatsoever and shall have no liabilities to pay any compensation to any person including drive r of the vehicle being involved in any accident or destructive activities. The contractor shall take full r esponsibility on all such legal matters as per Rules. The insurance of the vehicle should be the compr ehensive one and should cover the liability in respect of passengers / Officials also. 36. DVC shall not be liable for payment of any charge / compensation in case where: (a) Vehicle is under breakdown. (b) Vehicle remains idle due to STRIKE or any other reason beyond the control of any auth orities of Panchet, DVC. 37. If in the opinion of the Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet the performance of the contractor is not satisfactory with respect of quality of vehicle deployed or service rendered not c onforming to these terms & conditions of the contract, the corporation may terminate the contract wit hin 7 (seven) days’ notice in writing and such termination of the contract shall be final and binding up

on the contractor. 38. The contractor is also liable for termination by giving 3 (three) mo nths’ notice by the competent DVC authority without assigning an y reason whatsoever. 39. The Contractor will have to deploy only that vehicle which is conforming to the Clause - Requirements i.r.o. of the vehicle - of this Terms & Conditions. In case of breakdown of any of the above-mentioned vehicle, the contracto r may engage vehicle in good condition for a short time and purely on tem porary basis with prior approval of the Concerned Authority. However, the contractor should take initiative to re-deploy the vehicle conforming to the Clause - Requirements i.r.o. of the vehicle within 48 hours. 40. PENALTY: - (A) A penalty of Rs. 1500 (One Thousand Five Hundred) only for the vehicle will be imposed on the co ntractor for failure to provide the vehicle for the whole day. (B) If the Contractor deploys vehicle whose quality is not as per NIT (e.g. if registration is older than 5 years from the date of NIT) for more than 3 consecutive days in a month, no hiring charges as well as no fuel charges (running charges) i.r.o. the vehicle will be paid. (C) During idle hours on duty, the vehicle shall be parked with driver at a location as instructed by M anager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet. If vehicle / driver is found missing at any tim e during duty hours, penalty at prorata hourly rate of deduction to be made i.r.o. that vehicle @ Maximum KM run X Rate per KM -------------------------------------- Total days of month X 9 41. Maintenance of Time Route Schedule for each and every trip is the essence of the contract. The Time Schedule will be given to the successful contractor from the Concerned Authority or his authorized repres entative on day-today basis (At 5.30 P.M.) for the schedule of next day. If there is any delay on the part of the contractor in providing the vehicle for any journey or the vehicle provided by the contractor is not con forming to the quality standard mentioned in the Clause - Requirements i.r.o. of the vehicle - of Term & Co nditions of contract or the driver(s) or helpers are not physically and mentally healthy condition to drive th e vehicle. The Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet may cancel any trip/trips or not p roviding the vehicle for whole day and penalty will be imposed as per the appropriate sub-clause of the PE NALTY CLAUSE 42. No charges will be paid to the Contractor for non-engagement days or run of vehicle not scheduled/di rected by the Manager/any Other officer, HR Department, DVC, Panchet 43. No escalation / reduction in K.M. run rates will be admitted / recovered during the period of contract e xcept for Statutory Increase / Decrease in the price of Diesel by Govt. Oil companies (Petroleum Price Reg ulation Authority) during the contract period. Increase / Decrease on running cost (variable cost) will be ca lculated only to the extent of Diesel rate prices variation as mentioned in the NIT 44. The Detailed Route Chart with Timings etc. will be given to the successful contractor after placement of contract. As the vehicle timings are subject to change, day to day engagement and Timing and Route C hart Schedule of the vehicle are also subjected to change and will be issued / informed to the successful c ontractor before the trip begins
